theme_concept.name: Verdant Growth (Editorial Structural)
theme_concept.description: A completely new, distinctive UI for Evoque-Nova that rejects typical generic fintech templates (indigo/blue). Rooted in E1's 'Organic & Earthy' archetype mixed with 'Swiss Structure'. Utilizes deep forest greens, pale sage, and striking coral/terracotta accents. This communicates grounded wealth, organic growth, and elite structural clarity. Features raw typographic hierarchy, cardless grids with 1px borders, and high-contrast focal points.

typography.import_instructions: Import 'Clash Display' and 'Satoshi' via Fontshare. Import 'JetBrains Mono' via Google Fonts.

rules.h1: font-display text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-semibold tracking-tighter leading-none text-text-primary
rules.h2: font-display text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-medium tracking-tight text-text-primary
rules.overline: font-body text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-text-tertiary

dashboard_home.structure: Bento Grid (Control Room style) on desktop, linear vertical stack with generous spacing (p-6, p-8) on mobile. Avoids independent floating cards; uses full-width sections or structural borders.

wallet_balance.design: Typographic Hero. No card container. A large, stark greeting above a massive balance number using the mono font. Generous top padding. Balance text should have a subtle text-shadow for depth.
wallet_balance.actions: Two prominent buttons inline or directly below. 'Deposit' is solid --accent-main (coral punch), 'Withdraw' is an outline button with --border-default and --text-primary.

daily_claim.design: A dense, high-contrast structural banner spanning the width. Background is --surface-alt with a 1px solid --border-default. Contains a pulsing green status dot, the claim amount in mono, and an 'Active' or 'Claim Now' button. Countdown timer sits inline with mono font.
daily_claim.micro_interaction: On claim, button scales down slightly, checkmark animates in, and background flashes --success briefly.

announcement_banner.design: Editorial layout. Left side: Text and CTA. Right side: Image (optional). Background uses a textured --brand-soft fill. Sharp rounded corners (radius). Instead of heavy drop shadows, use a 1px --border-light. It should feel like a premium magazine snippet.

featured_plan.design: Immersive 'Poster' card. Aspect ratio 4:3 (mobile) or 16:9 (desktop). Uses an abstract green geometric background image with a gradient overlay (`bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 via-black/30 to-transparent`). All text inside is forced to white/light mode. Stats (Daily %, Days) exist in a subgrid at the bottom, mimicking a data dashboard overlay on art.
featured_plan.cta: Large full-width button at the bottom of the card or sticky in the subgrid, using --brand color.

secondary_section.design: Horizontal scroll / Carousel of 'Pill Cards'. These are tall, narrow widgets (aspect ratio 3:4) with soft backgrounds (--surface). They look like premium tactile clay objects (Neumorphism touch). Contains 'Invite & Earn', 'Redeem', etc.

welcome_modal.design: Crystal Glassmorphism. `backdrop-blur-2xl` with `bg-surface/80` (or `bg-white/70` light, `bg-black/60` dark). 1px inner border. Top half features a high-quality abstract image. Bottom half uses centered typographic storytelling with an --accent-main CTA.

mobile_bottom_nav.concept: The 'Floating Glass Pill'. Detached from screen edges (e.g., bottom-6, left-4, right-4).
mobile_bottom_nav.style: backdrop-blur-xl bg-surface/80 border border-border-default shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)]. Flex layout with space-between.
mobile_bottom_nav.items: Icons use Lucide React. Inactive: text-text-tertiary. Active: Icon changes to --brand, and the item gets a soft --brand-soft background oval.
mobile_bottom_nav.center_action: The 'Invest' or 'Home' center button is extruded. It breaks the pill bounds (floats slightly higher) and is a solid circle with --brand or --accent-main background and white icon.

desktop_sidebar.style: Fixed left. Background is --app-bg. Right edge is a strict 1px solid --border-default. No drop shadow.
desktop_sidebar.active_state: Active link has a left border highlight (4px solid --accent-main) and background becomes --surface-alt.

css_recipes.glass-panel: backdrop-blur-xl bg-surface/70 border border-white/20 (dark: border-white/10) shadow-lg
css_recipes.btn-primary: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-brand text-white font-medium transition-all hover:bg-brand-hover hover:scale-[0.98] active:scale-95
css_recipes.btn-accent: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-accent-main text-white font-medium transition-all hover:bg-accent-hover hover:-translate-y-0.5 shadow-md hover:shadow-lg
css_recipes.metric-num: font-mono text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-text-primary
css_recipes.grain: before:content-[''] before:fixed before:inset-0 before:opacity-[0.03] before:pointer-events-none before:bg-[url('data:image/svg+xml;base64,')] z-50

featured_plan_bg.description: Abstract green geometry to be used with a dark overlay for the Featured Investment Plan poster.

welcome_modal_art.description: Minimalist plant in terracotta pot. Represents organic wealth growth for the Welcome Modal.

announcement_banner_image.description: Modern African business lifestyle portrait to be used in the announcement or team sections.

testing_attributes.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case representing their role.
